structural_review.notes: Triangle mode, valid GLB length, UVs and embedded 1024px base colour checked. Requested targets are approximate; actual triangle count and target deviations are reported separately, within the user-specified 3000-prop / 8000-character ceilings. Scale, pivot, topology and visual quality require separate review.

visual_review.notes: Accepted after closing unintended receiver-to-barrel ring separation with a 12-triangle matching material collar. Original geometry and 1024 paint retained. Actual front, side, back, underside and three-quarter reviewed; barrel rings/cluster connected and no unintended receiver holes. Actual model has SIX stylized visible muzzle openings; explicitly accepted as a visual variation from five-count approval note. +Z muzzle direction, 0.85m Z length, origin at measured trunnion pair centre with axle +X. Separate asset; no operator, rig or animation. Neutral mount fixture passed; animated pitch sweep remains owner work.

import_review.notes: Real scene vertices and indices decoded; finite positions/UVs; retained embedded 1024px base colour. Uniform root transform; raw file preserved. Origin is the measured pair-of-boss bounding centre; no character pose, rig or animation added.
import_review.pitch_sweep: Not qualified; owner will rig and position later.
